mods.name: GrimStats Client
mods.description: Shows server-wide rankings from a GrimStats server inside the vanilla statistics screen, plus a leaderboard browser.

releases.notes:
### Added
- Players screen: full server roster with online indicator, last-seen time, and sorting by
  activity, recency, mob kills, K/D, or name, plus name search and an online-only filter.
- Player profile screen mirroring the web dashboard: highlights with server-wide ranks,
  combat panel (kills, deaths, player K/D, damage dealt/taken in hearts, most killed and
  killed-by mobs), top mined blocks, and distance breakdown. Reachable from the Players
  screen, by clicking any leaderboard entry, or `/grimstatsc players`.
- In-game config screen (API URL, token, port, fetch limit, rank badge and tooltip toggles)
  with live-resolved API status, opened from the Rankings screen, `/grimstatsc config`, a
  keybind, or ModMenu when installed.
- GrimStats keybind category in Options > Controls with bindings for the Server Rankings
  and config screens.
### Changed
- Leaderboard fetch limit changes now apply without restarting the game.
### Fixed
- Stats hidden by the server (403) now say so in the Rankings screen instead of showing
  the misleading "server not reachable" error.
- List scrollbars are draggable again: vanilla places the bar 8px right of the rows, which
  fell outside the mod's narrow list widgets where clicks are never delivered.
